== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Asylum is one of several significant worlds designated for protection by the [[Abidan]]. Along with [[Cradle]], [[Haven]], and [[Sanctum]], it serves as a vital bastion that the organization intends to collect and quarantine to safeguard against total system collapse and infinite chaos. Due to its strategic importance, the world is defended by [[Sector Eleven]], making it a high-priority target for certain threats. While currently considered relatively [[safe]] due to the presence of [[Oth’kimeth]], Asylum is also a location where individuals capable of threatening [[Judges]] are held in captivity. Furthermore, the site is identified as the birthplace of [[Subject One]] and was originally intended to function as a prison for that specific being.}}
